identification: Three Australian vintage valve mantel radios, not tested: (1) Healing 'Golden Voice' plastic mantel radio, cream/grey grille; (2) AWA Radiola cream bakelite/plastic mantel radio with AWA logo and Australian station dial; (3) brown bakelite HMV (His Master's Voice, The Gramophone Company Ltd, Sydney) mantel radio with cream louvred grille; brown one has a visible crack/repair on the top. Estimate 30-50, bid $15.

searches_tried: comps.py (pipeline) for AWA Radiola bakelite, HMV bakelite radio, Healing Golden Voice; work/comps.py bakelite radio (3 years, 38 local hits, median $62). Three WebSearch queries failed because the search budget was used up, so no web comps were found; no direct-source fetches made. Only Leski sales are non-local competitive results and they are for the 1940s bakelite Golden Voice, not this grey plastic 5-valve model. Plain mantel radios of this type sit around $20-80 each locally; the Golden Voice grey is likely the best of the three but still modest. eBay sold listings would settle resale. | chrome: Google Healing Golden Voice; Terapeak AU sold: healing golden voice (50 rows), awa radiola bakelite radio (48 rows), hmv bakelite valve radio (25 rows).

viewing_check: Estimate 30-50, bid $15, premium 22%. Three radios, not tested, brown bakelite HMV has a crack in the top, cream AWA is stained. Check for missing knobs/back and damage. Typical comparable sold prices for single sets are $10-110, mostly $37-75 for cream/brown sets, so about $100-150 for all three at best. Prices in 2024-2026 look flat. Heavy and fragile to post.
